source.conversion: T = 88 − 3.2 × (E_best − E) / 100, E the nation's Elo on 2003-10-13 (the day after the final) and E_best the best of the teams active in the four years before (Germany, 2087.4); the XI (1 GK, 4 DF, 4 MF, 2 FW, the most minutes) ordered by World Cup awards, goals a minute and minutes; its k-th player T + D_k, D = +4.9, +2.6, +1.9, +1.2, +0.3, −0.2, −0.7, −1.3, −1.7, −2.7, −4.3, rounded so the XI sums to round(11 × T)
